Implement JSON Merge Patch applyMergePatch (RFC 7386)

Adds applyMergePatch(target, patch), which merges a patch into a target as RFC 7386
section 2 defines it: null members are removed, object members merge recursively, and
other values replace the target whole. Adds node:test coverage for the appendix A
examples and the rules, and documents the function in the README.
